allow_instructions: Allow read-only git inspection, git fetch, pnpm lint/typecheck/test/build/docs:check/ci:classify, frozen-lockfile install, node --test, and node .cursor/run-isolated-e2e.mjs.
Allow GitHub inspection only: gh pr view, gh pr checks, gh run view, gh run list, and gh run watch.
Allow PowerShell diagnostics Get-FileHash, Get-Item, Test-Path, and Write-Output.
Allow read-only PowerShell filters Select-String and Select-Object without scriptblocks.
State-changing git add, normal git commit, feature-branch git push origin HEAD, and gh pr create are authorized by the WorkOS project hook, not by this allowlist.
block_instructions: Block git push --force, git push --force-with-lease, +refspec force push, and any push to main or master, including git push origin HEAD when the current branch is main or master.
Block gh pr merge, gh api calls to /pulls/<n>/merge or /merges, and git merge into main or master.
Block git reset --hard, destructive git clean, recursive destructive delete, opaque wrappers, direct pnpm e2e, direct Playwright, real Cloud mutation, and destructive database reset or drop.
